description: This script is a test file for a diff indentation heuristic in a version control system, likely Git. It contains tests that compare diff outputs under various heuristic and configuration settings, using test data and assertions.

methods.name: compare_diff
methods.description: Compares two diff output files after removing index lines, asserts they are identical.

methods.name: compare_blame
methods.description: Compares blame output lines after filtering out boundary commits, asserts they are identical.
